namespace Nonempty185Isolated
theorem generic {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β → γ)
    {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) :
    (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty := hs.image2 ht
theorem generic_iff {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β → γ)
    (s : Set α) (t : Set β) :
    (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty := Set.image2_nonempty_iff
#print axioms generic
#print axioms generic_iff
end Nonempty185Isolated

  s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty

theorem Set.Nonempty.image2.{u_1, u_3, u_5} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α}
  {t : Set β}, s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty :=
fun {α} {β} {γ} {f} {s} {t} x x_1 ↦
  match x with
  | Exists.intro w ha =>
    match x_1 with
    | Exists.intro w_1 hb => Exists.intro (f w w_1) (Set.mem_image2_of_mem ha hb)

  (Set.image2 f s t).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty
